recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-7744 unless a later pharmacy issue reintroduces brand/manufacturer wording that conflicts with this historical clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-7744 was a Published/Persuasive pharmacy clarification for DSTU1 Medication.isBrand, asking to change "Set to true if the item is attributable to a specific manufacturer (even if we don't know who that is)" to "Set to true if the item is attributable to a specific manufacturer."
initial_application: Imported SVN commit d91b3dd12ebf8d20c92cbacb33f72d8ac7bf010f (#7744, #7745 - Fixed typos in Medication) changed source/medication/medication-spreadsheet.xml so the historical Medication.isBrand definition no longer contained the parenthetical.
additional_context: Medication is still an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The old spreadsheet source has since been replaced by source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml, and current active Medication source no longer contains Medication.isBrand or the removed parenthetical. Commit 2559032b9b70469227fe6944b3732cd4295341dc, implementing broader FHIR-13879 Medication updates, replaced the old isBrand spreadsheet row with manufacturer-related content before the later StructureDefinition migration. The same historical SVN commit also applied FHIR-7745, which is already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the requested wording change was already applied historically and no active current FHIR core source still contains the obsolete parenthetical or target element.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-7745 was applied in the same imported SVN commit as FHIR-7744 and is already audited on the combined branch as commit 9141df29a1a345c57b3ab37eba03c293680eae50.
A broader later Medication resource update changed the old isBrand spreadsheet row into manufacturer-related content, helping explain why the FHIR-7744 target element is absent from current source.
